description.narrative: The UNIDO Country Programme (CP) document forms the frame of reference for technical cooperation between the Government of Uganda and UNIDO. It is a result of extensive consultations with the Government, key national stakeholders and development partners. It constitutes the commitment of UNIDO, the Government and other local partners towards the achievement of desired national objectives for inclusive economic growth and industrial development. The CP is directly linked to and aligned with the long term, overarching goals embedded in the National Development Plan of Uganda (NDP 2010/11-2014/15) as well as the United Nations Development Assistance Framework (UNDAF 2010-14). Consistent with relevant priorities of the Government of Uganda and in line with UNIDO#s strategic focus, four operational components have been identified to address Uganda#s industrial developmental process: - SME Development with a Focus on Youth and Women - Support to Quality Infrastructure and Standards - Agribusiness Development with a Focus on Selected Value Chains - Renewable Energy Development The CP will fundamentally be premised on private sector promotion/development through a value addition approach. UNIDO assistance is expected to make a significant contribution to Uganda#s National Development Plan which aims at economic grow
